shortDescription: Manage AFM global rule settings on BIG-IP

options.name: description
options.description: Description for the global list of firewall rules.

options.name: enforced_policy
options.description: Specifies an enforced firewall policy. C(enforced_policy) rules are enforced globally.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: service_policy
options.description: Specifies a service policy that would apply to traffic globally. The service policy is applied to all flows, provided there are no other context specific service policy configurations that override the global service policy. For example, when a service policy is configured both at a global level and on a firewall rule, and a flow matches the rule, the more specific service policy configuration in the rule will override the service policy setting at the global level. options.name: staged_policy
options.description: Specifies a staged firewall policy. C(staged_policy) rules are not enforced while all the visibility aspects (statistics, reporting, and logging) function as if the staged-policy rules were enforced globally.
